name: Netorare Princess ~Hime mo Joou mo Onna Kishi mo, Kizuita Toki ni wa Netorare Zumi~
original_name: 寝取られプリンセス ～姫も女王も女騎士も、気付いた時には寝取られ済み～
source:
[i]Elencia, a princess and lovely flower of the kingdom, with whom the protagonist met by a finger of fate, traveled with, and swore to protect for the rest of his life.
Iris, Commander of the Imperial Guard, with whom the protagonist traveled and risked their lives to protect the princess.
Nadia, mother of Elencia and a beautiful empress, who saved the protagonist's life.[/i]

In his adventurous days after saving the princess, the protagonist of the story guards the kingdom in order to keep the heroines safe. The one he truly desired and loved was the princess—and yet, the fact that he managed to get her was nothing more than a dream.

He received a position and an honor, but he was still just one person. He lost his precious woman. Nefarious hands are drawing closer to the one he deeply loved, got out with, and became a lover with. Women get exposed before the eyes of men with different capacities and fetishes and fall into depravity.

[b]The protagonist can only watch the heroines as they are defiled by lust. Are there zero happy endings?! This is the beginning of a full netorare adventure game![/b]

[Translated from [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/ntrp/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
[i]艾莲西亚，王国的公主，可爱的花朵，主角与她命运之指相遇，一起旅行，并发誓一生守护。
艾丽丝，帝国卫队指挥官，主角与她一起旅行，冒着生命危险保护公主。
娜迪亚（Nadia），埃伦西亚（Elencia）的母亲，美丽的皇后，拯救了主角的生命。[/i]

故事的主人公在拯救公主后的冒险日子里，为了保护女主角的安全而守护王国。他真正渴望和爱的人是公主——然而，他能得到她却只是一场梦。

他获得了地位和荣誉，但他仍然只是一个人。他失去了他最珍贵的女人。邪恶的手正在靠近他深爱的人，并与之分手，并成为情人。女人暴露在不同能力、不同癖好的男人面前，陷入堕落。

[b]主角只能眼睁睁地看着女主角们被情欲玷污。幸福结局是零吗？！这是一个完整的netorare冒险游戏的开始！[/b]
